credentials.note: Agents never hold bank credentials. Envoy issues a short-lived Guild session token to the selected bank agent after two-key approval; the bank agent presents it to its own /execute.

notes: Evaluation: deny patterns win over allow; anything not allowed is denied.
client_agent may never call a bank endpoint directly; it only talks to Envoy. envoy:/execute_selected asks Envoy to orchestrate: Envoy mints the Guild token and the bank agent executes.
Only bank agents may call bank_*:/execute, and only with an Envoy-issued Guild session token.
